tools.name: followup
tools.description: Add, remove or list this session's follow-ups. A follow-up is a check with nothing to do now that can only be done later (e.g. look at the replies in 3 days and decide on a price cut / try it for a few days and see whether it helped / resume once a wait is over). Follow-ups show above the prompt in Claude Code Desktop, so the person sees them before archiving the session. action: add takes what, when (a time, or what has to happen first) and how (where to look, what decides it); due_at (ISO 8601 with offset) when the time is fixed. action: done takes the id and removes it (checked, no longer needed, or moved to a scheduled task). action: list lists them.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
